# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome stand, charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It lists at $109 and was about $80 at Best Buy and $90 at Amazon. The 36W power supply is included and the warranty is 2 years. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It charges at Qi2 25W, with a glossy black finish and a heavy base that lets you lift the phone off one-handed. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station.** It was listed at about $40 on Amazon, down from $80. It charges at 15W and includes a power brick and cable. The Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Best for travel or desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99).** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. Macworld says smaller, lighter rivals exist. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))

**Other options:**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2):** WIRED's best travel pick at about $80, 15W. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Nimble Podium 3-in-1:** Lies flat, supports Qi2 25W, and is $130–$140. Apple Watch charging is slow. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **ESR CryoBoost (Qi2.2, 25W):** A folding stand with a fan, listed at $99.99, with a 50W adapter included. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)) Dealectric lists it with a code (PARTNER18) that it says brings it to $82. That is an affiliate link and I haven't verified the code: [ESR CryoBoost on Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). Dealectric's claim that it is the "only" fit reflects only its own catalog, not the whole market.

**Which to choose:** Faster 25W charging only helps with an iPhone 16 or 17 and matters little for overnight charging, which WIRED also points out. The Belkin is the best all-rounder, and the ESR is the best value.

My search results didn't include direct retailer links for most of these, so the WIRED pages above link to current Amazon, Best Buy and brand listings. Prices change, so check them before buying.
